author: Ifmyante
text:
Hi C-12

There certainly is more that fear and greed to get over in this
business. There's also the balance between chart life and real life to
be set and maintained.

If you don't have the complete support of your loved ones, you may find yourself living in some very dark days.

It's a long and sometimes lonely road we must walk. To an observer we
simply look like we're sitting passively at the screen, but in reality,
we're fighting demons daily, living through great victories and crushing
 defeats, on our way to mastering the market.

We must make our partners aware of every step we take, and also listen
to their concerns. We are making a journey into the unknown, but at
least we are choosing the route. They have no such control, and this can
 make them panic if they're not kept fully up to speed on progress.

So, communication is key. Always let your loved ones know where you are
with it, and always listen to their concerns. When listening, really
listen. Switch off those charts that forever seem to tick away in your
head, and SEE the person before you. Their feelings and opinions really
count in your life, so heed them, and find a way to make a balance
between the great future you're making and the great present you could
be missing out on
